PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT ?dialect
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?dialectLemma) AS ?count)
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?linkedDialectLemma) AS ?linkedLemmas)
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?italianLemma) AS ?italianLemmas)
WHERE {
  ?dialectLemma dcterms:isPartOf ?dialect .
  FILTER(?dialect IN (<http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank>,
                      <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank>))

  OPTIONAL {
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?dialectLexEntry .
    ?dialectLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?linkedDialectLemma .
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    ?italianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/lemma/LemmaBank> .
    FILTER(?linkedDialectLemma = ?dialectLemma)
  }
}
GROUP BY ?dialect
ORDER BY ?dialect
